statistic_keys.r_{tag}|{naive,eiv}, gamma_{tag}|{naive,: teacher / non-teacher-BA slope ratio and gamma = ratio / (1 - eta + eta ratio); tag main = teachers with a BA control, nobac = without, tba = BA teachers only, ntc/nt = against all non-teachers
